Theorem
[Backward uniqueness for solutions of Ricci flow] Source: chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-iii:page-0232, page-0233 1. ch22:22.20\group Uniqueness

If $g_1(t)$ and $g_2(t)$ are complete bounded-curvature Ricci flows on $[0,T]$ with $g_1(T)=g_2(T)$, then $g_1(t)=g_2(t)$ for every $t\in [0,T]$.
